notes.hook: The threat of a particle jet fired directly at our planet is a high-stakes, immediate hook.
notes.clarity: The narrative successfully transitions from detection to the physics of the tidal disruption event.
notes.payoff: The 'down the barrel' explanation effectively justifies the unusual brightness and duration of the event.
notes.visuals: The CGI renders are high quality, though the actual telescope data in beat 6 is visually quite plain.
notes.loop: The final metaphor of the 'shredder' flows perfectly back into the opening description of the black hole.

rounds.better_than_last: This Short achieves a more seamless narrative loop than the recent deep-space telescope episode while maintaining the same level of hook intensity.
